name: sn_erp_integration API
title: sn_erp_integration API - Scoped, Global
summary: Script include providing a chainable API for interacting with Zero Copy Connector for ERP (Enterprise Resource Planning) models.
overview:
This script include requires the Zero Copy Connector for ERP (com.sn_erp_integration) store application and is provided within the sn_erp_integration namespace. For more information, refer to Zero Copy Connector for ERP.

Role required: sn_erp_integration.erp_user

Metadata
Use metadata methods to discover the system, model, and IDoc information available in your Zero Copy Connector for ERP environment.
  • getAvailableSystems()
  • getAvailableModels()
  • getAvailableOperations()
  • getAvailableInputs()
  • getRequiredInputs()
  • getAvailableOutputs()
  • getAvailableIdocConfigs()
Configuration
Use configuration methods to select available systems, models, operations, and IDoc configurations for processing. You can also use these methods to filter model field return values.
  • system()
  • model()
  • operation()
  • idocConfig()
  • fields()
  • limit()
  • offset()
Query building
Use query building methods to filter results.
  • addEncodedQuery()
  • addQuery()
  • addOrQuery()
Data input
Use the data input methods to set field values. The withJSON()method can be used for input on nested objects and IDoc fields. The set() method is used to set a single field value.
  • set()
  • withJSON()
Operation execution
Use the execute() method when working with multiple records, and the get() method for results of a single record.
  • execute()
  • get()

members.name: API constructor

members.html:
Parameters

The following examples show how to create an instance of the API to access an ERP system.

// Select the system1 system

members.name: addEncodedQuery
members.summary: Filters records using an encoded query.
members.html:
See also:
  • API - addOrQuery(String field, String operator, String value)
  • API - addQuery(String field, String operator, String value, String joinType)
  • API - fields(Array fields)
Parameters
Name Type Description
encodedQuery String An encoded query string.
Returns
Type Description
Object Returns this instance for chaining.

The following example shows how to use an encoded query to retrieve company codes in the US.

const api = new sn_erp_integration.API()
  .system('system1')
  .model('company_code')
  .operation('read')
  .addEncodedQuery('company_codes_countryregion_key=US')
  .execute();

members.name: addOrQuery
members.sig: addOrQuery(String field, String operator, String value)
members.summary: Add an OR query condition.
members.html:
See also:
  • API - addEncodedQuery(String encodedQuery)
  • API - addQuery(String field, String operator, String value, String joinType)
  • API - fields(Array fields)
Parameters
Name Type Description
field String The name of the field to be queried.
operator String Optional. Query operator. The query option used depends on whether data provided for the value parameter is a number or string.

Default value: =

Numbers:
  • =
  • !=
  • >
  • >=
  • <
  • <=
Strings (must be in upper case):
  • =
  • !=
  • IN
  • NOT IN
  • STARTSWITH
  • ENDSWITH
  • CONTAINS
  • DOES NOT CONTAIN
Note:
Use CONTAINS instead of the LIKE operator.
value String Value on which to query (not case-sensitive).
Returns
Type Description
Object Returns this instance for chaining.

The following example shows how to return all company codes in the US and Canada.

const api = new sn_erp_integration.API();
const companyCodes = api
  .system('system1')
  .model('company_code')
  .operation('read')
  .addQuery('company_codes_countryregion_key', 'US')
  .addOrQuery('company_codes_countryregion_key', 'CA')
  .fields(['company_codes_company_code', 'company_codes_company_name', 'company_codes_countryregion_key', 'company_codes_currency'])
  .execute();

// Process the results
companyCodes.forEach(companyCode => {
  gs.info('Company Code: ${companyCode.company_codes_company_code}, Name: ${companyCode.company_codes_company_name}, Country: ${companyCode.company_codes_countryregion_key}');
  
  // Do something with each company code
  if (companyCode.company_codes_countryregion_key === 'US') {
    // Process US company codes
  } else {
    // Process Canadian company codes
  }
});

members.name: addQuery
members.sig: addQuery(String field, String operator, String value, String joinType)
members.summary: Add a query condition for filtering data.
members.html:
See also:
  • API - addEncodedQuery(String encodedQuery)
  • API - addOrQuery(String field, String operator, String value)
  • API - fields(Array fields)
Parameters
Name Type Description
field String The name of the field to be queried.
operator String Optional. Query operator. The query option used depends on whether data provided for the value parameter is a number or string.

Default value: =

Numbers:
  • =
  • !=
  • >
  • >=
  • <
  • <=
Strings (must be in upper case):
  • =
  • !=
  • IN
  • NOT IN
  • STARTSWITH
  • ENDSWITH
  • CONTAINS
  • DOES NOT CONTAIN
Note:
Use CONTAINS instead of the LIKE operator.
value String Value on which to query (not case-sensitive).
joinType String Optional. Join type.
Possible values:
  • AND
  • OR
Default value: AND
Returns
Type Description
Object Returns this instance for chaining.

The following example shows how to use the > operator to return results that are priority one or a priority greater than two.

// Results in: priority=1^ORpriority>2
const api = new sn_erp_integration.API();
  .system('system1')
  .model('request')
  .operation('read')
  .addQuery('priority', '1)
  .addOrQuery('priority', '>', '2')
  .execute();

members.name: execute
members.summary: Executes the configured operation.
members.html:
To execute an operation on a single result, use API - get().

Parameters
Name Type Description
None
Returns
Type Description
Object|Array The result of the operation. Error if unsuccessful.

The following example shows how to create a new company code.

const newCompanyCode = new sn_erp_integration.API()
  .system('system1')
  .model('company_code')
  .operation('create')
  .withJSON({
    company_codes_company_code: '1234',
    company_codes_company_name: 'New York Office',
    company_codes_countryregion_key: 'US',
    company_codes_language_key: 'EN'
  })
  .execute();

members.name: fields
members.summary: Specifies the model fields to return. This is the primary method for field selection.
members.html:
To retrieve a list of fields available for a model, use API - getAvailableOutputs().

See also:
  • API - limit(Number max)
  • API - offset(Number start)
Parameters
Name Type Description
fields Array One or more model field names listed as strings.
Returns
Type Description
None

The following example shows how to return specific fields for all company codes in the US.

const companyCodes = new API()
  .system('system1')
  .model('company_code')
  .operation('read')
  .addQuery('company_codes_countryregion_key', 'US')
  .fields(['company_codes_company_code', 'company_codes_company_name', 'company_codes_countryregion_key'])
  .execute();

members.name: get
members.summary: Alias for the execute() method for retrieving a single record in the results.
members.html:
See also API - execute().

Parameters
Name Type Description
None
Returns
Type Description
Object The first result of the operation.

The following example shows how to retrieve a specific sales document.

const salesDoc = new sn_erp_integration.API()
  .system('system1')
  .model('sales_document')
  .operation('read')
  .addQuery('document_number', '0000123456')
  .get();

members.name: getAvailableIdocConfigs
members.summary: Gets the available IDoc configuration details for the selected system.
members.html:

None

See also API - system(String systemId).

members.name: getAvailableInputs

members.name: getRequiredInputs
members.summary: Returns of list of only the required input fields for the selected model and create operation.
members.html:
Required input fields are set when models are created.

For a complete list of input fields for a selected model, use the API - getAvailableInputs() method.

Parameters
Name Type Description
None
Returns
Type Description
Array of objects List of required input field names.
object.variable_name Variable name of the required input field.

Data type: String
object.label Display name of the required input field.

Data type: String
object.data_type Data type of the operation required input.

Data type: String
object.required Flag that indicates whether the input field is required. This method only returns results if the value is true.

Data type: Boolean

The following example shows how to return the required input fields for creating an invoice.

const requiredInputs = new sn_erp_integration.API()
  .system('system1')
  .model('invoice')
  .operation('create')
  .getRequiredInputs();

gs.info(JSON.stringify(requiredInputs, null, 2));

Output:

{
  "variable_name": "INVOICE01",
  "label": "INVOICE01",
  "data_type": "array",
  "required": true
}

members.name: idocConfig
members.summary: Selects an IDoc configuration to operate on.
members.html:
See also:
  • Outbound message configuration fields
  • Outbound message IDoc status for IDoc log tab fields
Parameters
Name Type Description
configId String ID of the IDoc outbound configuration. To retrieve a list of IDoc configuration IDs, use the API - getAvailableIdocConfigs() method.
Returns
Type Description
Object Returns this instance for chaining.

The following example shows how to select an IDoc configuration and set values for processing.

const api = new sn_erp_integration.API()
  .system('system1')
  .idocConfig('OBC0001002')
  .withJSON({
    idoc_field1: 'value1',
    idoc_field2: 'value2'
  })
  .execute();

members.name: limit
members.summary: Limits the number of results returned.
members.html:
Parameters
Name Type Description
max Number Maximum number of records to return.
Returns
Type Description
Object Returns this instance for chaining.

The following example shows how to retrieve only the first 10 company code records.

// Get only the first 10 company codes
const api = new sn_erp_integration.API()
  .system('system1')
  .model('company_code')
  .fields(['company_codes_company_code', 'company_codes_company_name'])
  .limit(10)
  .execute();

members.name: model
members.summary: Selects a model to operate on.
members.html:
Parameters
Name Type Description
modelId String The ID of the model.

To retrieve a list of all models with their IDs, use API - getAvailableModels().
Returns
Type Description
Object Returns this instance for chaining.

The following example shows how to select the company_code model in system1. You can chain additional methods for getting and setting data for the selected model.

const api = new sn_erp_integration.API()
  .system('system1')
  .model('company_code')
  .execute();

members.name: offset
members.summary: Sets the starting offset for results.
members.html:
Parameters
Name Type Description
start Number Starting point at which to begin retrieving results. For example, setting this value to 10 skips the first 10 results returned in a query.
Returns
Type Description
Object Returns this instance for chaining.

The following example shows how to retrieve 10 company code records skipping the first 10 results (11-20).

const api = new sn_erp_integration.API()
  .system('system1')
  .model('company_code')
  .fields(['company_codes_company_code', 'company_codes_company_name'])
  .limit(10)
  .offset(10)
  .execute();

members.name: operation
members.summary: Selects an operation to use on a selected model.
members.html:
To return a list of model operations, use API - getAvailableOperations().

Parameters
Name Type Description
operationId String The ID of the model operation.
Returns
Type Description
Object Returns this instance for chaining.

The following example shows how to select the read operation for the company_code model.

const api = new sn_erp_integration.API()
  .system('system1')
  .model('company_code')
  .operation('read')
  .execute();

members.name: set
members.summary: Sets a single field value for create or update operations.
members.html:
Parameters
Name Type Description
field String Name of the field on which to set a value.
value String Value to set for the field.
Returns
Type Description
Object Returns this instance for chaining.

The following example shows how to create a company code entry and assign field values to it.

const api = new sn_erp_integration.API()
  .system('system1')
  .model('company_code')
  .operation('create')
  .set('company_codes_company_code', '1234')
  .set('company_codes_company_name', 'New York Office')
  .set('company_codes_countryregion_key', 'US')
  .set('company_codes_language_key', 'EN')
  .execute();

The following example shows how to update a sales document with nested properties. For nested data structures with additional levels, use API - withJSON(Object data).

const api = new sn_erp_integration.API()
  .system('system1')
  .model('sales_document')
  .operation('update')
  .set('document_number', '0000123456')
  .set('header.document_type', 'OR')
  .set('header.sales_organization', '1000')
  .execute();

members.name: withJSON
members.summary: Sets JSON data for the operation. For read operations, this method sets filter conditions. For create or update operations, this method sets the fields with data to be created or updated.
members.html:
See also API - set(String field, String value).

Parameters
Name Type Description
data Object JSON data listing fields and their values.
Format:
{fieldname: 'value'}
Returns
Type Description
Object Returns this instance for chaining.

The following example shows how to set data for a create operation.

const api = new sn_erp_integration.API()
  .system('system1')
  .model('company_code')
  .operation('create')
  .withJSON({
    company_codes_company_code: '1234',
    company_codes_company_name: 'New York Office',
    company_codes_countryregion_key: 'US'
  })
  .execute();

The following example shows how to set a nested filter for a read operation.

const api = new sn_erp_integration.API()
  .system('system1')
  .model('sales_document')
  .operation('read')
  .withJSON({
    header: {
      document_type: 'OR',
      sales_organization: '1000'
    }
  })
  .operation('read')
  .execute();
